The [[Miniature Varesh]] is a [[miniature]] version of [[Varesh Ossa]].

==Acquisition==
*[[Nightfall Collector's Edition Present]]

==Notes== 
*She is holding a [[Suntouched Scythe]].
*As opposed to [[promotional weapon]]s, which can be obtained multiple times, you can only get this miniature ''once''.

==Trivia==
*Varesh was originally weaponless, but was given one when the players requested it.
